independentLayers.description: The modal layer on the floating layer foundation (dom/floating.ts): top layer for backdrop and popup, dismiss layer (Escape, outside press), focus scope (trap and return), scroll lock, the rest of the page inert, nesting.
Swipe to dismiss: the popup follows a drag toward its edge (--drawer-swipe-movement-x / -y, data-swiping) and closes past the threshold (data-swipe-dismiss, reason swipe).
Reference numbers for the sheet's padding, gap and size per side.

intent: Slide a panel of navigation, filters or a short task in from an edge of the screen, with swipe to dismiss

properties.description: Whether the drawer is open. Setting it fires no openchange; a trigger press, Escape, an outside press, a close part or a swipe set it unless openchange is canceled.
Open at first connect when no open attribute is present (Base UI defaultOpen).
Base UI modal: true (focus trapped, page scroll locked, the rest of the page inert), trap-focus (focus trapped only) or false (the page stays interactive; focus leaving closes it).
Outside presses (the backdrop) do not close it; Escape and close parts still do (Base UI disablePointerDismissal).
Text of a generated title (an h2 that names the popup). Ignored when the popup has an authored title.
Text of a generated description under the title (aria-describedby). Ignored when the popup has an authored description.
The viewport edge the sheet is anchored to, slides in from and is swiped away toward (Base UI swipeDirection: bottom = down, top = up). Physical: it does not mirror in RTL.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Gap between the popup's parts in units of u (0…8 in steps of 0.5); default the collection gap (2u).

events.name: openchange
events.trigger: the trigger is pressed, Escape is pressed, a press lands outside the sheet, a close part is pressed, the sheet is swiped toward its edge, or (modal false) focus leaves; preventDefault keeps the drawer as it is (a canceled swipe springs back on the next open)

semantics.role: none (the popup is role=dialog, aria-modal while modal)

keyboard.action: open the dialog (the trigger is a button)
close the topmost open drawer or dialog
move focus among the popup's tabbables, wrapping (modal and trap-focus)

sources: the title (label property or an authored [data-part=title]) through aria-labelledby

content.children: Popup content (any elements), or authored [data-part=trigger], [data-part=backdrop] and [data-part=popup] children. Inside the popup: [data-part=title], [data-part=description], [data-part=actions] and any number of [data-part=close] elements (usually ui-buttons); an [autofocus] element takes focus on open. Elements marked [data-swipe-ignore] (and text entry, sliders) never start a swipe.

constraints: The host draws no box (display: contents; the manifest's layout schema has no contents value): only its trigger takes space in the page.

The sheet is square (area family): it meets the viewport edge. Left and right sheets are the viewport height and 80u wide, at most the viewport less 8u; top and bottom sheets are the full width and at most the viewport height less 8u, scrolling inside past it.

A press dragged toward the edge moves the sheet with the pointer; released past 40% of its size, or flicked, it closes with reason swipe, otherwise it springs back. Dragging away from the edge does not move it.
Modal by default, as the dialog: page scroll locks, the rest of the page is inert, focus is trapped and returns to the trigger.
Sides are physical (a swipe direction is physical): side="left" stays on the left in RTL.
Setting open from script changes it without an openchange event.

avoidWhen.when: A question or a short form that is not tied to an edge of the screen.
avoidWhen.reason: A dialog (ui-dialog) centers it; an alert dialog asks for a decision.

avoidWhen.when: Navigation that stays visible beside the content on wide screens.
avoidWhen.reason: Lay it out as a panel in the page; a drawer covers the page while open.
